1_inbound_to_reply_ms.interpretation: Make duration_ms includes post-send Sleep. User-visible reply ≈ time until Gupshup 87 (~3–4.5s typical). Full scenario avg ~6.2s.

3_delay_sleep_retry.verdict: Two FunctionSleep modules (77, 88) with duration=1 → 1 second each (~+1000ms measured after Gupshup). No Retry flags on modules. Sleep is AFTER send → does not delay that WhatsApp bubble, but extends run ~1s and can slow the queue.

4_openai_api.note: ai-agent:RunAnAIAgent (84 + 63) calls LLM under the hood — largest gap before reply (~1.9–3.6s). Module 58 Gupshup often 400 Bad Request (failed alternate route).
